data.body: Landed: Gerrit change 3247 patch set 1 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1 from GitHub Actions run 41569525871, 0 unresolved) merged as e03877e0b84a403af9f4f93a24b35b862f96ea8c on origin/main; GitHub mirror confirmed.
